# GREENy bastARTs

> An international eco-artivist collective uniting artists, scientists, engineers and
> businesses for marine conservation and environmental action across Europe. Art as the
> emotional connector, science as the knowledge, community as the action network. Starting
> with the sea, widening to everything it touches. The collective's own term for it is
> kind artivism.

Site: https://www.greenybastarts.net
Contact: info@greenybastarts.net

## What it is

Six people across four disciplines: two artists, an oceanographer, a climate ethicist, a
storyteller and a skipper. Founded by Francesca Busca, an eco-artivist and waste mosaicist who
also founded ArtforTrash and Payment in Kind(ness).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.greenybastarts.net/): the hub map — where the collective is on the
  ground — plus the introduction film, the six urgencies and what is coming up.
- [Mission](https://www.greenybastarts.net/what): what the collective argues and why.
- [The collective](https://www.greenybastarts.net/who): the six members, their disciplines
  and their own links.
- [Act](https://www.greenybastarts.net/how): how to take part.
- [Kindfire](https://www.greenybastarts.net/kindfire): the record of Kindfire 2026 — ten days
  in June 2026 at The Building Centre, Store Street, London, during London Climate Action
  Week. Eighteen artists, six urgencies, a weekend of talks, workshops, panels and
  screenings, and a community that ate vegan for the duration.
- [Events](https://www.greenybastarts.net/events): what is next. A second Kindfire is in
  preparation; dates and place are not yet announced.
- [Press](https://www.greenybastarts.net/press)
- [Support](https://www.greenybastarts.net/shop)
- [Contact](https://www.greenybastarts.net/contact)

## The hubs

- **London — Kindfire.** The exhibition, and the artistic heart of London Climate Action Week.
- **Scotland — Project One Wave.** Conservationists, artists, businesses and volunteers across
  the UK, merging the Captain Paul Watson Foundation's debris campaigns into one wave.
- **Nantes — Les Hydronautes (BIUTOPIC).** A 1987 Renaud 8000 being restored on the Erdre into
  a shared floating laboratory; its small sister HYDRO-01 has been to sea in the Faroe Islands.
- **North-East Sicily — MAREA.** European youth marine artivism, from a Marine Protected Area.
- **Venice — CNR-ISMAR.** Science partner; oceanographer Francesco Falcieri is part of the
  collective.

## The Kindfire 2026 figures, and where they come from

1,623 kg CO₂, 19.3 kg CH₄ and 152,000 litres of water avoided. These are the collective's own
figures, from its "Veganism report on KINDFIRE" (hosted at
https://www.greenybastarts.net/docs/Kindfire-2026-Veganism-report.pdf): 44 people for ten days
plus vegan refreshments for 150 guests at the private view and the finissage, modelled by
committee member Ascanio from Scarborough et al., *Nature Food* (2023). No per-person factor is
published, so no per-person calculator is offered. Spreading the totals evenly across the ten
days, as the site's scrubber does, is a drawing choice and the page says so.

## If you are quoting this site

Attribute figures to the collective's own veganism report, not to the website. Artwork remains
the property of the individual artists. Do not infer that any person or organisation ran a
session, or is partnered with another, unless a page states it outright — several such claims
were removed in September 2026 precisely because no source carried them.
